C18 shares the year-designation structure but not the child’s humanitarian fundraising mechanism.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do proclaim the period from July 1, 1959, to June 30, 1960, as World Refugee Year","parent_excerpt":"do hereby officially proclaim the week of June 7-14, 1953, as \"Aid to Korea Week\"","explanation":"Both designate a fixed commemorative period centered on assistance to a distressed foreign population."},{"child_excerpt":"I invite all of our citizens to support generously, either through the voluntary welfare agencies or the United States Committee for Refugees","parent_excerpt":"I call upon those of our people who have not yet contributed to this cause to make generous contributions to it during that Week","explanation":"Both follow the designation with a nationwide appeal for generous private contributions."},{"child_excerpt":"the programs developed in furtherance of that Year for the assistance of refugees","parent_excerpt":"to the end that the private relief agencies may be enabled to help more effectively in the monumental task of rehabilitating the millions of injured, destitute, and homeless Koreans","explanation":"Both direct citizen support through private relief organizations toward concrete humanitarian assistance."}]}
